# The eight released rows the Engram head fixtures are built from, as hex.
#
# Provenance: read read-only from the published deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash snapshot
# fb2764a5cf321eaa5070ca8f9e892818f477c16d by probe_rows.py, from
#   layers.1.engram.embed.weight   at data0 + id*256   (256 weight bytes)
#   layers.1.engram.embed.scale    at data0 + id*8     (8 scale bytes)
# and the same two tensors on layer 14. 2112 bytes of row data and 2672 bytes of
# safetensors headers were read in total; nothing was written and no other byte was touched.
#
# Line format: ROW <layer> <id> <256 weight bytes hex> <8 scale bytes hex>
# 384006167 is the last row of layer 1 and 384016681 the last row of layer 14, which is what
# makes the "the tail is data, not padding" claim checkable.
#
# Licence: reference/LICENSE is MIT (Copyright (c) 2023 DeepSeek) and reference/MODEL_CARD.md:183
# states the model weights are MIT too, so these bytes may be redistributed with the notice kept.
# RE-REVIEW IF THIS REPOSITORY IS EVER MADE PUBLIC.
ROW l1 0  7878777878787878
ROW l1 1  7878787878787878
ROW l1 4095  7878787878787878
ROW l1 12345678  7878787878787879
ROW l1 384006167  7877787778787778
ROW l14 0  7878787878787878
ROW l14 7  7878787878787878
ROW l14 384016681  7877777878787878
